slices.description: Centralize runtime at HOME and accept an explicit project root.
steps: Tests prove init installs runtime under HARNESS_HOME and creates no project bin directory.
Tests prove centralized harness commands operate on the requested project root without crossing into a second project.

slices.description: Require explicit Claude/Cursor adapter selection and install native skill layouts.
steps: Tests cover explicit Claude and Cursor layouts, interactive prompt, and noninteractive unknown-host failure before mutation.
Cursor installs .cursor/skills and generate no .cursor/rules; Claude installs .claude/skills and .claude/agents.

slices.description: Persist per-project host metadata and route lock/update checksums by adapter.
steps: Tests prove two projects with different adapters update independently using their own lock mappings.
Tests prove edited managed files remain intact and are written to .new on upstream conflict.

slices.description: Make doctor/status use the selected layout through the centralized runtime.
steps: Tests prove doctor and status accept explicit project root for both adapters.
Tests prove diagnostics inspect the selected skill path and report missing host metadata or skills.

slices.description: Safely remove unchanged legacy project executables and preserve edited files.
steps: Tests prove lock-matching legacy bin scripts are removed during migration.
Tests prove edited legacy scripts are preserved and repeated migration is idempotent.

slices.description: Update docs, gates, manifest, and changelog for centralized runtime and adapters.
steps: Focused searches find no active project-bin command examples or Cursor skill rules guidance.
Full tests and separate L2 evaluation confirm docs match both installer layouts and migration behavior.
